warnings: Two spread footings on soil, no piles, both 0.25 thick with the top 1.00 below ระดับดินเดิม, 0.05 lean concrete 1:3:5 and 0.05 compacted sand below (คอนกรีตหยาบ 1:3:5 / ทรายหยาบอัดแน่น). F1 = 0.40 + 0.40 = 0.80 square with 5+5-DB12; F2 = 0.50 + 0.50 = 1.00 square with 6+6-DB12. main_bar.count is the two-way total (section 6b); both print RB 9 รัดรอบ as a single edge tie (count 1, no spacing).
Both views are kept in one file (one element each, no id collision) like the S-04 footing files of houses 93/95.
The column C1 runs down to each footing (drawn with its ties); no separate pedestal size is printed, so no pedestal fields are added.
